text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Since my body is still so young and racing 
is tough on me, Trainer studies hard every 
single day for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
She even enlisted the help of Agnes 
Tachyon-san, and is investigating so, so 
many things for me...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Your feelings make me so, so happy. Just 
knowing that gives me the strength to 
think, "I'm going to do my absolute best 
too!"
